sourceMeaning: Actual compact task/artifact metadata and rejected self-target proposal. Unit test is a prospective new feedback view, never a replay or modification of the old run. DAG uses the actual saved pre-synthesis working observation; artifact metadata is limited to actual snapshots registered by the self-target proposal timestamp. Later final-product artifacts are not resurrected into the historical candidate list.

steps.title: 任务拆解与依赖规划
acceptanceCriteria: 交付可核对的结果并说明限制。

steps.title: Clarify objectives and draft proposal design
acceptanceCriteria: Client objectives, horizon, and risk tolerance confirmed or reasonable assumptions documented
Draft allocation framework and proposal outline produced

steps.title: Research US market and asset evidence
acceptanceCriteria: Current US equity/asset evidence with public sources and gaps documented
Concise research brief published as artifact

steps.title: Assess risks and suitability
acceptanceCriteria: Key risks and suitability against client profile assessed
Structured verdict with evidence and any bounded rework requests

steps.title: Draft client-friendly introduction
acceptanceCriteria: Allocation rationale and risks explained in plain language
Draft introduction artifact published for review

steps.title: Review final proposal and introduction
acceptanceCriteria: Draft introduction and allocation claims independently checked against research and risk findings
Structured review verdict with evidence and rework requests if needed

steps.title: Synthesize final simulated investment proposal
acceptanceCriteria: Final proposal includes allocation, reasons, risks, and client introduction
All prior role outputs and review verdicts incorporated
Synthesize actual research sources, execution evidence, reviewer verdicts and limitations; do not replace missing verification with prose.

actualRejectedProposal.feedback: Independent editorial/evidence review of the current drafts (research brief artifact-234b668bbc6c44f99be52ed6b45b7f3f, risk assessment artifact-4ded7dd927cd482db49d5307d35cf8df, client introduction artifact-88db95b663d347dda7dd99dd8302b24c). All sourced numbers in the introduction reconcile with the brief (CAPE 39.95, P/B 6.00, P/S 3.73, div yield 1.07%, 10y 5.15%, fwd P/E 18.09x/19th pct, fwd ERP +0.38%, trailing ERP -1.28%); no fabricated or contradicted claims found. Bounded rework required before pass: D-1 (marketing) add plain-language US dividend withholding-tax note for a HK resident, labelled unverified — F-3 only partially met; D-2 (marketing) relabel the 70万-80万 drawdown and 10% FX figures as illustrative scenarios, not measured statistics (no drawdown series was retrieved); D-3 (fund_manager) the final synthesized proposal task-49f7edf1bf1d4b6c is still pending with no artifact — it must state the assumed profile as an assumption, carry all material risks in plain language, include the withholding-tax disclosure, flag ETF expense/tracking as unassessed, and not present the forward-P/E 'cheap' read without the trailing/CAPE counterpoint; D-4 (research, optional) no primary source fetched, aggregator-only data must remain disclosed. Verdict: REWORK (bounded). Confidence moderate. Full review published as artifact-5b74a9d9d5cb4a779cda9977b10b6619.
